what_this_is_not: R values are copied from the tracked fixture. Julia values are computed fresh by tools/true_parity_julia_receipts.jl, which repeats the computation of the cited twin test with the same inputs and settings; R was not run and is not recomputed here.

cases.quantity: loglikelihood(fit) at each side's own optimum, ranks d = 1, 2, 3
cases.julia_source: GLLVModels.loglikelihood(fit_gaussian_gllvm(Y; X, K)), as at test/test_model_comparison.jl:122; fits as at test/test_model_comparison.jl:118
cases.note: Julia fits the fixture's own response matrix (Y_wide) with fit_gaussian_gllvm(Y; X = per-species intercepts, K), K = 1, 2, 3, as in the test; R's values are the recorded P1 gllvmTMB fits of the same data and nested ranks. The test uses this looser tolerance because the two optimisers are independent.
